title: Fix deployment environment discovery pagination
summary: Deployment environment discovery now fetches all pages of environments from GitHub instead of only the first page, ensuring CI/CD includes all available deployment targets.
key_points: Fetches environments in pages of 100 until a page contains fewer results
Retains full environment metadata for branch-policy filtering across all pages
Handles edge case where environment count is exact multiple of 100
Propagates failures on subsequent pages to prevent incomplete deployment selection
Covers regression scenarios including empty results, page boundaries, and second-page branch policies
quote: GitHub returns 30 environments by default, but deployment discovery previously fetched only one page.
